decision: The derived variants file and the generation cache are the fixed evaluation artifact. Every step downstream of generation is byte-reproducible from them (run 2 of run_variants_eval.sh reproduced run 1 byte-identically from the cache). Generation itself is seeded but not bit-reproducible on the CPU backend: in the cache spot check 8 of 179 sampled sentences differed by 1-3 words. Both files are archived at submission under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, the licence of the Nahmias et al. (2024) data they derive from; they are not committed to git.
